newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says no plan to change JGB investment stance.
newsitem.headline: MOF says no plan to change JGB investment stance.

text.p: The Finance Ministry's Trust Fund Bureau has no plan to change its investment stance towards Japanese government bonds (JGBs), an official of the bureau said on Wednesday.

When asked whether the bureau had decided to cut its investment in JGBs, the official told Reuters in a telephone interview: "We have absolutely no plans to change anything, nor have we announced any changes."
JGBs fell in early afternoon trade on Wednesday on a rumour that the Trust Fund Bureau might scale back the amount of its outright purchases of JGBs.
Earlier this month, the bureau said it planned to buy 2.4 trillion yen worth of long-term JGBs in fiscal 1997/98.
The Trust Fund Bureau resumed outright purchases of JGBs in June 1996.
